name: Combined (Graphiti + SimpleMem)
one_line: Deployed server joining a Graphiti + Neo4j graph, a SimpleMem + Weaviate vector store and a session transcript.

arch.product.t: Deployed FastAPI server with three memory paths (graph, vector, transcript)

arch.truth.t: No single truth: Neo4j and Weaviate written by a best-effort fan-out

arch.stores.t: Neo4j, Weaviate (entries, transcript, sessions), PostgreSQL (auth), optional Valkey

arch.scope.t: Graph is user-wide (project_user); vectors filtered by project, user and session

write.entry.t: post_message per turn; legacy add_message posts user then assistant under one request id

write.receipt.t: Transcript awaited; graph job only enqueued; stored_in labels are not a durability receipt

write.roles.t: User turns go to the graph, assistant turns to vectors only, system skipped

segment.unit.t: One graph episode per turn; vector windows of 10, but a live call is a window of one

extract.calls.t: About 5-8 per user turn and 1 per assistant turn (inferred)

extract.facts.t: SimpleMem lossless_restatement JSON from assistant turns; no dedupe

extract.episode.t: Graph episode is the raw turn text

extract.dates.t: SimpleMem resolves relative dates; Graphiti valid_at from source time

extract.neighbours.t: Graphiti shows previous episodes; SimpleMem shows previous-window entries

extract.failure.t: 3 parse retries; some live batch errors only logged

graph.resolution.t: Deterministic first (exact, fuzzy, MinHash with entropy gate); LLM only for holdouts

graph.edges.t: RELATES_TO fact edges with fact embedding and supporting episodes

graph.communities.t: Optional; retrieved but not written into the context

time.fields.t: Bi-temporal edges: valid_at / invalid_at and created_at / expired_at

time.update.t: LLM marks duplicate or contradicted edges; code sets invalid_at

time.dedup.t: Graph dedupe; vector entries deduped by id only

derive.session.t: Updated on every user turn (250 words), rebuilt every 20

derive.profile.t: User summary from 10 episodes, rebuilt every 10; [USER PROFILE] block

index.embed.t: Cohere embed-english-v3, 1,024-d; queries embedded in document mode (defect)

index.lexical.t: BM25 on edges and episodes; BM25 on restatement text only (keyword field unused)

read.rewrite.t: History-aware LLM reformulation, once per call

read.analysis.t: Vector planner LLM: up to 2 semantic queries plus keywords

read.legs.t: Graph: edges (BM25 + cosine + BFS), episodes (BM25), communities. Vector: semantic top 5 (cos ≥ 0.5) and BM25 top 5

read.temporal.t: Planner resolves dates against the wall clock (defect for history)

rank.fusion.t: RRF inside graph result types; union by id in vectors; no cross-store fusion

rank.agentic.t: Reflection (completeness check), off; stops on an empty first result

answer.shape.t: Three independent blocks (graph, vector, last-N); graph part undated; no global rank

answer.prompt.t: Short grounded JSON prompt with an exact abstention phrase

eval.models.t: Qwen3-32B reader planned; F1 + strict 0/1 judge

eval.rigour.t: Delegates to the official evaluator; errors stay in the denominator; hashes

keep: Graphiti bi-temporal edges with deterministic-first entity resolution
Session and user summaries kept current on every user turn
Evaluator delegates to the official LoCoMo scorer and keeps errors in the denominator
avoid: Undated graph context and a placeholder 0.8 relevance score
No fusion across stores; three blocks concatenated
Queries embedded in document mode; planner uses the wall clock
stored_in labels overstate durability; empty string on backend failure

extras.t: Dependent follow-ups rewritten once per call from paired answered history
Optional recent answered exchanges returned as their own block
Old transcript rows move to a passive collection and are revived on read

token_economy.t: No explicit context budget: three independently formatted blocks (graph, vector, optional last-N) are concatenated; the all-session benchmark mode repeats whole blocks. Session summary capped at 250 words; vector extraction compresses turns into restatements.

speed.t: Live graph writes return on enqueue (per-thread serial queue); vector extraction runs up to 8 workers over windows of 10; reads gather graph, vector and history concurrently. Heavy write cost (235B + 32B models, about 5-8 calls per user turn).

locomo.protocol: No LoCoMo result exists; harness would report official F1 and a strict 0/1 judge
